You can now send `safety_identifier`, an opaque end-user identifier assigned by your application, on Chat Completions, the Responses API, deferred chat completions, the Batch API, and the gRPC `GetCompletionsRequest`. It lets SpaceXSI attribute a policy violation to one of your end users rather than to your API key. The legacy `user` field is still accepted.
